verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר שִׁמְעוּ־ נָא֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּקְצִינֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲל֣וֹא לָכֶ֔ם לָדַ֖עַת אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar šim·‘ū- nā rā·šê ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·qə·ṣî·nê bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl hă·lō·w lā·ḵem lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ’eṯ- ham·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Then I said Hear now O leaders of Jacob you rulers of the house of Israel Should you not . . . know justice
verses.literalPt: Eu disse: Ouvi, cabeças de Jacó e chefes da casa de Israel; não é a vós que pertence saber o juízo?

verses.original: שֹׂ֥נְאֵי ט֖וֹב וְאֹ֣הֲבֵי רָעָה גֹּזְלֵ֤י עוֹרָם֙ מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וּשְׁאֵרָ֖ם מֵעַ֥ל עַצְמוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: śō·nə·’ê ṭō·wḇ wə·’ō·hă·ḇê rå̄·ʿå̄h gō·zə·lê ‘ō·w·rām mê·‘ă·lê·hem ū·šə·’ê·rām mê·‘al ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: You hate good and love evil You tear the skin from my people and strip the flesh from their bones
verses.literalPt: A vós os que aborreceis o bem, e amais o mal, e que deles arrancais a pele, e dos seus ossos, a carne;

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר אָכְלוּ֮ שְׁאֵ֣ר עַמִּי֒ וְעוֹרָם֙ מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֣ם הִפְשִׁ֔יטוּ וְאֶת־ עַצְמֹֽתֵיהֶ֖ם פִּצֵּ֑חוּ וּפָרְשׂוּ֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּסִּ֔יר וּכְבָשָׂ֖ר בְּת֥וֹךְ קַלָּֽחַת׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·šer ’ā·ḵə·lū šə·’êr ‘am·mî wə·‘ō·w·rām mê·‘ă·lê·hem hip̄·šî·ṭū wə·’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·ṯê·hem piṣ·ṣê·ḥū ū·p̄ā·rə·śū ka·’ă·šer bas·sîr ū·ḵə·ḇā·śār bə·ṯō·wḵ qal·lā·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: You eat the flesh of my people after stripping off their skin . . . and breaking their bones You chop them up like flesh for the cooking pot like meat in a cauldron
verses.literalPt: os que também comeis a carne do meu povo, e deles arrancais a pele, e lhes quebrais os ossos, e os repartis em pedaços como para a panela e como carne dentro do caldeirão.

verses.original: אָ֚ז יִזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲנֶ֖ה אוֹתָ֑ם וְיַסְתֵּ֨ר פָּנָ֤יו מֵהֶם֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵרֵ֖עוּ מַעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’āz yiz·‘ă·qū ’el- Yah·weh wə·lō ya·‘ă·neh ’ō·w·ṯām wə·yas·têr pā·nāw mê·hem bā·‘êṯ ha·hî ka·’ă·šer hê·rê·‘ū ma·‘al·lê·hem
verses.literal: Then they will cry out to the LORD but He will not answer them At that time He will hide His face from them because of the evil they have done
verses.literalPt: Então, clamarão a Jeová, porém não lhes responderá; esconderá deles a sua face naquele tempo, conforme fizeram o mal nos seus feitos.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים הַמַּתְעִ֣ים אֶת־ עַמִּ֑י הַנֹּשְׁכִ֤ים בְּשִׁנֵּיהֶם֙ וְקָרְא֣וּ שָׁל֔וֹם וַאֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא־ יִתֵּ֣ן עַל־ פִּיהֶ֔ם וְקִדְּשׁ֥וּ עָלָ֖יו מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘al- han·nə·ḇî·’îm ham·maṯ·‘îm ’eṯ- ‘am·mî han·nō·šə·ḵîm bə·šin·nê·hem wə·qā·rə·’ū šā·lō·wm wa·’ă·šer lō- yit·tên ‘al- pî·hem wə·qid·də·šū ‘ā·lāw mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says As for the prophets who lead My people astray who proclaim peace while they chew with their teeth but declare war against one who puts nothing in their mouths
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová acerca dos profetas que fazem errar o meu povo; que mordem com os dentes e clamam: Paz; e preparam a guerra contra aquele que não lhes mete na boca alguma coisa.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן לַ֤יְלָה לָכֶם֙ מֵֽחָז֔וֹן וְחָשְׁכָ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם מִקְּסֹ֑ם וּבָ֤אָה הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ עַל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְקָדַ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên lay·lāh lā·ḵem mê·ḥā·zō·wn wə·ḥā·šə·ḵāh lā·ḵem miq·qə·sōm ū·ḇā·’āh haš·še·meš ‘al- han·nə·ḇî·’îm wə·qā·ḏar ‘ă·lê·hem hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Therefore night will come over you without visions and darkness without divination The sun will set on these prophets and the daylight will turn black over them
verses.literalPt: Portanto, vós tereis noite sem visão e tereis trevas sem adivinhação; por-se-á o sol sobre os profetas, e sobre eles se obscurecerá o dia.

verses.original: וּבֹ֣שׁוּ הַחֹזִ֗ים וְחָֽפְרוּ֙ הַקֹּ֣סְמִ֔ים וְעָט֥וּ עַל־ שָׂפָ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑ם כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין מַעֲנֵ֖ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇō·šū ha·ḥō·zîm wə·ḥā·p̄ə·rū haq·qō·sə·mîm wə·‘ā·ṭū ‘al- śā·p̄ām kul·lām kî ’ên ma·‘ă·nêh ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced They will all cover . . . their mouths because there is no answer from God
verses.literalPt: Serão envergonhados os videntes, e confundidos, os adivinhadores; todos eles cobrirão a parte inferior do rosto, porque não há resposta de Deus.

verses.original: וְאוּלָ֗ם אָנֹכִ֞י מָלֵ֤אתִי כֹ֙חַ֙ אֶת־ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּגְבוּרָ֑ה לְהַגִּ֤יד לְיַֽעֲקֹב֙ פִּשְׁע֔וֹ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חַטָּאתֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām ’ā·nō·ḵî mā·lê·ṯî ḵō·aḥ ’eṯ- rū·aḥ Yah·weh ū·miš·pāṭ ū·ḡə·ḇū·rāh lə·hag·gîḏ lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ piš·‘ōw ū·lə·yiś·rā·’êl ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw
verses.literal: As for me however I am filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD with justice and courage to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin
verses.literalPt: Eu, porém, na verdade, estou cheio de poder pelo Espírito de Jeová, e de juízo, e de força, para declarar a Jacó a sua transgressão e a Israel o seu pecado.

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־ נָ֣א זֹ֗את רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּקְצִינֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַֽמֲתַעֲבִ֣ים מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַיְשָׁרָ֖ה יְעַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū- nā zōṯ rā·šê bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·qə·ṣî·nê bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ha·mă·ṯa·‘ă·ḇîm miš·pāṭ wə·’êṯ kāl- hay·šā·rāh yə·‘aq·qê·šū
verses.literal: Now hear this O leaders of the house of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel who despise justice and pervert all that is right
verses.literalPt: Ouvi isto, cabeças da casa de Jacó e chefes da casa de Israel, que abominais o juízo e perverteis toda a equidade.

verses.literal: who build Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with iniquity
verses.literalPt: Edificam a Sião com sangue e a Jerusalém, com iniquidade.

verses.original: רָאשֶׁ֣יהָ׀ בְּשֹׁ֣חַד יִשְׁפֹּ֗טוּ וְכֹהֲנֶ֙יהָ֙ בִּמְחִ֣יר יוֹר֔וּ וּנְבִיאֶ֖יהָ בְּכֶ֣סֶף יִקְסֹ֑מוּ וְעַל־ יְהוָה֙ יִשָּׁעֵ֣נוּ לֵאמֹ֔ר הֲל֤וֹא יְהוָה֙ בְּקִרְבֵּ֔נוּ לֹֽא־ תָב֥וֹא עָלֵ֖ינוּ רָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rā·še·hā bə·šō·ḥaḏ yiš·pō·ṭū wə·ḵō·hă·ne·hā bim·ḥîr yō·w·rū ū·nə·ḇî·’e·hā bə·ḵe·sep̄ yiq·sō·mū wə·‘al- Yah·weh yiš·šā·‘ê·nū lê·mōr hă·lō·w Yah·weh bə·qir·bê·nū lō- ṯā·ḇō·w ‘ā·lê·nū rā·‘āh
verses.literal: Her leaders judge for a bribe her priests teach for a price and her prophets practice divination for money Yet they lean upon the LORD saying Is not the LORD among us No disaster can come upon us
verses.literalPt: Os seus cabeças dão sentenças por peitas, os seus sacerdotes ensinam por interesse, e os seus profetas adivinham por dinheiro; todavia, se encostarão a Jeová e dirão: Acaso, não está Jeová no meio de nós? Nenhum mal nos sobrevirá.

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ בִּגְלַלְכֶ֔ם צִיּ֖וֹן שָׂדֶ֣ה תֵֽחָרֵ֑שׁ וִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ עִיִּ֣ין תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְהַ֥ר הַבַּ֖יִת לְבָמ֥וֹת יָֽעַר׃פ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên biḡ·lal·ḵem ṣî·yō·wn śā·ḏeh ṯê·ḥā·rêš wî·rū·šā·lim ‘î·yîn tih·yeh wə·har hab·ba·yiṯ lə·ḇā·mō·wṯ yā·‘ar
verses.literal: Therefore because of you Zion will be plowed like a field Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble and the temple mount a wooded ridge
verses.literalPt: Portanto, por causa de vós Sião será lavrada como um campo, Jerusalém se tornará em montão de pedras, e o monte da casa, como os altos dum bosque.
